WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment" AS segment,
        LEFT(ym."date", 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR'
      AND LEFT(ym."date", 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."segment", LEFT(ym."date", 4)
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY segment
),
calc AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        consumption_2012,
        consumption_2013,
        (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) AS increase_abs,
        
        CASE
            WHEN consumption_2013 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2013) * 100
        END AS pct_increase
    FROM pivoted
)

SELECT
    'biggest' AS metric,
    segment,
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    increase_abs,
    pct_increase
FROM calc
WHERE pct_increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'lowest' AS metric,
    segment,
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    increase_abs,
    pct_increase
FROM calc
WHERE pct_increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pct_increase ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;
